description: Fact check claims against sources: up to 10 claims checked against up to 4 source URLs you name; each comes back SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED or UNSUPPORTED with the exact quote the verdict rests on. Use it to verify AI output, citations or statements before publishing. Input: claims[], sources[]. A question but no sources yet: research.web. $5.00 per call. Returns: claims[], verdicts[{claim,verdict,quote,source_n}], sources_read[], sources_unread[], model.

language.description: Optional answer language, BCP-47 (en, ja, pt-BR). Default: the input's.

name: hubvibe_verify_claims
title: Verify claims against sources
